topic: git 版本功能消失（版本回退事故链——与 B49/B50 相关）
text:
**用户：**


**AI：**
## Goal
- Build and enhance the KFM v4 floating card system: fix zoom pinch for terminal/tmux cards, add fullscreen orb (topMidOrb), refactor card creation pipeline, and investigate a one-time slow page load issue

## Constraints & Preferences
- Follow KFM v4 心法 (design principles) in `docs/KFM_V4_INVARIANTS.md` — 17 principles, especially: no patches (#12), no cross-module deps (#3), simplify at source (#2), less code is better (#5)
- User prefers debugging via 02 log card output, not visual indicators
- All changes must pass `npm run check` (tsc + custom checks)
- Client bundle built with: `npx esbuild src/client/main.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=public/bundle.js --target=es2019 --external:katex --external:mermaid`

## Progress
### Done
- Fixed pinch zoom registration: moved `registerPinch` + keyboard listener from inside `_toggleExpandCollapse` closure to `initFloatingCards` top level (was only registering after first expand/collapse)
- Cleaned up diagnostic `[gesture]` and `[zoom]` logs from `gesture-registry.ts` and `floating-card.ts`
- Investigated one-time 20-30s page load: nginx access log showed WS connection transferring 2.2MB over 26s; concluded one-time network transient, not reproducible
- Added `topMidOrb` — fullscreen orb at top-center of card with blended color (70% color1 + 30% color2), 10×10 SVG maximize icon
- Orb visible from creation (no `display:none`), animates with launch animation
- Orb shows/hides in expand/collapse transitions, synced in all `onUpdate` callbacks
- Refactored `createFloatingCard` → `_createCardElement` (internal) + `_launchCard` (animation) + `createFloatingCard` (public, creates+launches) + `createCardElement` (public, creates only)
- Added `enterFullscreen()` / `exitFullscreen()` — saves position, hides orbs, injects shrink+close buttons, animates to viewport, keyboard avoidance via `visualViewport` resize
- Added fullscreen dismiss handling in `_dismissOne`
- Updated `tree-render.ts` file click path: `createCardElement` + `enterFullscreen` instead of `hit.gesture?.onTap?.()`
- Re-implemented all above after accidental `git checkout --` reverted everything

### In Progress
- Zoom reflow for terminal/tmux cards — CSS zoom doesn't change `offsetWidth`/`offsetHeight` → FitAddon's `fit()` skips `resize()` → terminal doesn't reflow

### Blocked
- Terminal/tmux zoom reflow: multiple approaches tried and failed:
  - CSS zoom on contentEl → doesn't trigger ResizeObserver
  - Changing card dimensions → card physically resizes (wrong)
  - Dispatching synthetic resize events → patch, violates principles
  - Font size change via `setZoom` interface → `fit()` still skips because `proposeDimensions()` reads same container size and cached character dimensions
  - Removing CSS zoom + font size only → made it worse

## Key Decisions
- Top orb uses blended gradient color (70/30 mix), not color2 alone
- Orb appears at animation start (not onComplete) to sync with card
- `activate` for terminal moved from expand `onComplete` to before animation (ResizeObserver tracks frames) — but reverted during zoom experiments
- `createCardElement` exported for fullscreen path (tree-render direct card creation)
- Fullscreen is single-slot: entering fullscreen on one card closes others
- Zoom: CSS zoom approach kept as default; `setZoom` interface approach attempted but incomplete

## Next Steps
- Design proper zoom reflow solution for terminal/tmux cards (the core unsolved problem)
- Verify all re-implemented features work after the revert+re-implement cycle

## Critical Context
- FitAddon `fit()` source: reads `getComputedStyle(parentElement)` for container size, divides by `css.cell.width/height` (cached character dimensions). Only calls `term.resize()` if calculated cols/rows differ from current. CSS zoom doesn't change `getComputedStyle` → `fit()` is a no-op during zoom.
- `proposeDimensions()` returns early if `css.cell.width === 0 || css.cell.height === 0`
- `_fsResizeHandlers` Map tracks fullscreen viewport resize listeners for cleanup
- `_loadZoom` reads from `localStorage` key `kfm-card-zoom:{typeId}`
- Base terminal font size is 9px (`terminal-card-04.ts:192`)
- `_launchCard` animates to `FLOATING_CARD_W × FLOATING_CARD_H` (240×288 default)
- Card state machine: `launching → active ↔ compact` (via expand/collapse), `active → fullscreen` (via topMidOrb click)
- `FS_Z = 20` (fullscreen z-index, below floating cards at `Z_FLOATING_BASE=50+`)

## Relevant Files
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/floating-card.ts` — main file, 264 lines added: _blendColor, zoom helpers, topMidOrb, _createCardElement, _launchCard, createCardElement, enterFullscreen, exitFullscreen, expand/collapse orb sync
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/tree-render.ts` — 20 lines added: import createCardElement/enterFullscreen, file click → fullscreen path
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/card-registry.ts` — CardContentHandler interface (unchanged in current state, `setZoom` was attempted but reverted)
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/terminal-card-04.ts` — terminal card handler, FitAddon usage, `fontSize: 9` base (unchanged)
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/tmux-card.ts` — tmux card handler (unchanged)
- `/root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/gesture-registry.ts` — pinch/keyboard zoom registration (unchanged)
- `/root/kfmv4/node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.mjs` — FitAddon source, `fit()` calls `proposeDimensions()` then conditionally `resize()`
- `/root/kfmv4/docs/KFM_V4_INVARIANTS.md` — 心法 principles (17 design rules)
- `/root/kfmv4/check-as-any.mjs` — (as any) whitelist, line 120 for terminal-card-04
